items.exampleEn: Follow this trail, and you will find a small lake.
items.exampleZh: 沿著這條小徑走，就會看到一座小湖。

items.exampleEn: Her white dress was soiled with paint.
items.exampleZh: 她的白洋裝被油漆弄髒了。

items.exampleEn: Many plastic bags end up in the ocean.
items.exampleZh: 許多塑膠袋最後流進了海洋。

items.exampleEn: Chicken wings are my favorite snack.
This country has a warm and wet climate.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家的氣候溫暖潮濕。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather worked in a steel factory.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺以前在鋼鐵廠工作。

items.exampleEn: The children built a castle out of sand.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們用沙子堆了一座城堡。

items.exampleEn: Smoke from factories goes into the atmosphere.
items.exampleZh: 工廠的煙排放到大氣中。

items.sentenceEn: The ocean was calm this morning.

items.audioEn: This trail is short and flat, so it's good for families with small children.
items.audioZh: 這條步道又短又平坦，很適合帶小小孩的家庭。

items.sentenceEn: Wet shoes will soil the carpet.
The plane's wing was covered with ice.

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my family walked along a trail by the ocean. The sand was warm, and the sea air was fresh. My sister, who studies chemistry, told me that the Earth's atmosphere protects us from the sun. On the way, we saw a big bird with long white wings. Near the beach, there was an old steel bridge. My sister said the climate here is getting warmer every year. At the end of the walk, my little brother fell in the mud and soiled his new shorts.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們全家沿著海邊的一條步道散步。沙子暖暖的，海風很清新。讀化學的姊姊告訴我，地球的大氣層保護我們不受太陽傷害。路上，我們看到一隻有著白色長翅膀的大鳥。海灘附近有一座舊的鋼橋。姊姊說這裡的氣候一年比一年暖。散步快結束時，我弟弟跌進泥巴裡，弄髒了他的新短褲。

questions.questionZh: 姊姊說地球的大氣層有什麼作用？
options: 保護我們不受太陽傷害

questions.questionZh: 散步快結束時，弟弟怎麼了？

referenceEn: My shoes are full of sand.
There is sand in my shoes.
rubricZh: sand 表示「沙子」，是不可數名詞，例如 full of sand 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 climate 造一個句子，說說你喜歡哪種氣候。
referenceEn: I like a cool, dry climate.
I don't like hot climates because I can't sleep well.
rubricZh: climate 表示「氣候」，例如 a warm climate 等說法
說的是自己的喜好（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
